messages:
noah (billing): ZenithCare (acct_8022) invoice INV-2026-612 failed 3 card attempts this morning. They asked for wire or ACH instead of retrying card. Can we provide instructions & confirm whether to waive late fee if they wire today? @rachel?

payments-bot: payment_attempt_failed: 3 attempts (2026-06-10T10:05:12Z, 10:12:48Z, 10:33:01Z) -> decline_code: issuer_declined; processor_note: processing_error

rachel (finance): Invoice is $3,620 due 2026-06-12. For mid-market accounts we can waive one late fee ($35) if funds are initiated same-day and treasury confirms posting within 72h. Need treasury + compliance sign-off on origin bank.

diego (acct-mgr): I talked to their AP — they prefer ACH (domestic) but can do same-day wire if ACH fails. They asked for a simple ACH block and a wire block for backup. Also asked who to email proof to.

noah (billing): ACH block (paste into email):
```
Bank: Redstone Clearing Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: 4455123344
ACH Routing: 111000025
Reference: INV-2026-612 / ZenithCare (acct_8022)
```
Wire block (paste if ACH not available):
```
Bank: Redstone Clearing Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: 4455123344
Routing (ABA): 111000025
SWIFT: RCBKUS55
Reference: INV-2026-612 / ZenithCare (acct_8022)
```
Please request a screenshot of the confirmation or ACH trace number and send to billing@redwood.ai.

ivy (treasury): Treasury checklist: require ACH trace or bank confirmation. If wire, require proof (MT103 or bank confirmation). We will not accept pooled originator accounts without additional AP contact verification. If origin bank differs from KYC, require 2 additional verification items.

compliance-bot: compliance_rule: if originator country != customer country OR originator bank not matching KYC -> require AP email + bank statement (last 3 months) OR live AP verification call.

rachel (finance): Approving conditional waiver: waive $35 late fee if proof of initiation received within 24 hours and funds post within 72 hours. If they insist on same-day service restore, require a signed payment plan acknowledgement before restoring service.

diego (acct-mgr): Sending email now with both ACH and wire details and the following snippet: "Please initiate payment using the block below. Reply with the ACH trace or wire confirmation (screenshot/MT103) to billing@redwood.ai. We will hold service suspension for 48 hours pending receipt. Upon treasury confirmation, we will mark INV-2026-612 as paid and waive the one-time late fee if conditions are met."

noah (billing): I'll update the invoice note and set status to 'awaiting bank transfer'. After treasury confirms, billing will tag finance & compliance and apply the waiver. Moving to action: await customer confirmation. :white_check_mark:
